extension.summary: Watch Twitch streams and chat from Kodi
extension.description: View Twitch streams using Kodi's own playback, with a paired IRC chat view. Not designed for chatting back to streamers - a second way to consume streamer-generated content.
extension.news: v0.6.0: Real stream playback via inputstream.adaptive; clicking a live channel in Home or Discover now plays it. v0.5.0: Discover screen (browse by game, channel search); fixed window navigation killing the script; fixed unreachable skin controls. v0.4.0: followed-games filter row on Home. v0.3.0: Home screen (followed channels, thumbnails, token refresh). v0.2.0: Twitch device-code login. v0.1.0: initial addon scaffold.
